**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User is planning a team-building event for their company.  
[FACT] User has been working in Roppongi for about 3 months.  
[PREFERENCE] User is interested in exploring more bars in Roppongi.  
[FACT] User works at a marketing firm.  
[EVENT] User is planning to have a casual team lunch instead of an after-work gathering.  
[PREFERENCE] User prefers a more casual, no-frills option for their team lunch.  
[FACT] User is looking for Korean restaurants in Roppongi that can accommodate a group of 10.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Roppongi has plenty of trendy restaurants with private rooms for team-building events.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended restaurants for team-building events include Sushi Saito, Narisawa, L'Atelier de Joël Robuchon, Toraji, and Bungalow.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended bars in Roppongi include Bar High Five, Star Bar, Nonbei Yokocho, The Bar at The Ritz-Carlton, Tokyo, Bar Orchard Ginza, Craft Beer Market Roppongi, and Velours.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended lunch spots in Roppongi for a group of 10 include Ichiran Ramen, Torigin, Bicchu, Katsu-Ya, Roppongi Hills Cafe, and Yakiniku Jumbo Han no Daidokoro Bettei.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended Korean restaurants in Roppongi include Han no Daidokoro Sushi Ko, Korean Kitchen, Onnuri, K-Pub, and Gwangjang.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Korean Kitchen offers a variety of traditional Korean dishes, including bibimbap, bulgogi, japchae, kimchi stew, and Korean fried chicken.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Korean Kitchen offers lunch sets, including a Bibimbap Set for ¥1,000, a Bulgogi Set for ¥1,200, and a Lunch Box for ¥1,500.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Lunch Box at Korean Kitchen includes a protein choice (beef, chicken, or pork), rice, kimchi, and a side dish.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Side dish options for the Lunch Box include kimchi, japchae, bokkeumbap, and gyeranjjim.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User can request specific sides or drinks to be included with the Lunch Box.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Reservations are recommended for Korean Kitchen, especially for a group of 10.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The atmosphere at Korean Kitchen is casual and no-frills, making it suitable for a quick, easy lunch.
